regressions.what: Individual light stones were easier to distinguish in the previous capture, while the current shelf blends into the streambed as a continuous tan band.

blockers.target: At half frame height the open water extends roughly from 11% to 87% of frame width.
blockers.current: The shorelines still pinch the water between approximately 20% and 70% of frame width at that height.
blockers.change: Cut the two midlake shelves back to the target endpoints at half frame height, keeping the near cut bank and the three outlet rocks in place.

blockers.where: A2–B3 left bank and E2–F4 right shoulder
blockers.target: Tall grasses and shrubs form continuous masses around the lake and over the shoulder, with one low stone showing above the right grass.
blockers.current: Denser short grass lines the outlet, but broad bare areas remain behind both banks and several large boulders stand clear on the right.
blockers.change: Extend overlapping blade and shrub clumps from both outlet edges across the bare shelves to the far shoreline, with taller clumps screening all but one low right-hand stone.

next.target: Broad olive vertical reflections give way to slate-blue shallows with narrow bright foam curling around the three grey rocks.
next.current: The calmer lake reflects separate blue and tan patches, and the brown outlet has weak grey streaks against rock faces that fall nearly black.
next.change: Reflect the vegetated shore as broad olive bands, retain a blue-grey surface over the visible bed, lift the rocks' shadowed faces and concentrate white foam along their waterlines.

next.target: A ragged rooted lip overhangs a lit brown slope with loose stones at its toe.
next.current: The lip has a rougher edge but still overhangs an almost black slot without a readable soil slope.
next.change: Bring the earth face forward below the lip, slope it into scattered toe stones and light the rough soil enough to distinguish it from the narrow root shadows.

next.target: Rounded grey pebbles and fist-sized cobbles form a raised wedge with dark gaps and scattered stones entering the grass.
next.current: A tan strip of small pale flecks runs flush into the channel and ends in a dense grass line.
next.change: Raise the fan above the bed and distribute grey stones of several sizes with visible sides and contact shadows, tapering their density inland through the grass.

unverifiable: Water flow and foam motion cannot be judged from still captures.
